tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Never pure white, never pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Inputs, unselected chips, secondary buttons and list rows sitting on paper.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: the track behind a segmented control, empty states, pressed rows. Never for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, the logo, primary buttons and selected chips (filled). 14:1 or more on paper, surface and tint in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an ink fill, such as a primary button or a selected chip.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hints, captions, metadata and secondary labels on paper, surface or tint (5:1 or more). Never on pick.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and list separators only. Too quiet for control outlines; use control for those.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, unselected chips and secondary buttons. Meets 3:1 against paper, surface and tint.

tokens.name: pick
tokens.usage: The brand yellow. Means one thing: this is the chosen place. Used for the pick ticket and the filled dot of the logo, nowhere else. Never for buttons, links, text or decoration.

tokens.name: on-pick
tokens.usage: All text and icons on pick, in both themes (9.6:1).

tokens.name: pick-rule
tokens.usage: The dashed perforation line across the pick ticket.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error messages and destructive confirmations only. Text on paper or surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name of the picked place on the ticket. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the main call to action.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: An Italian place with a garden out back.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Fact labels on the ticket, attribution, fine print.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side padding on phones; inner padding of inputs and rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Inner padding of the pick ticket; space between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above the main call to action and between major blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every tap target; space before the history list.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text inputs and the inner pill of a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented control track, list cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The pick ticket and other large surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Mood chips and anything that echoes the dots of the mark.
